basics.name: Prashant Palkar
basics.label: Assistant Professor
basics.summary: I am a faculty in the IEOR group in the Department of Mechanical Engineering at IIT Delhi. I work on theory, algorithms, software and applications of Optimization and Machine Learning. Recently, I have been working on some interesting projects in Indian Railways and Healthcare.

work.name: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi
work.position: Assistant Professor, IEOR, Department of Mechanical Engineering
work.summary: Working in the areas of Integer Programming, Machine Learning and Algorithmic Game Theory currently at IEOR, ME, IIT Delhi.

work.name: Institute of Mathematics, University of Augsburg, Germany
work.position: Postdoctoral Researcher, Chair of Discrete Mathematics, Optimization, and Operations Research
work.summary: Worked on Algorithmic Game Theory, in particular, on computation of Nash Equilibrium in Dynamic Traffic Assignment for Electric Vehicles
work.homepage_description: Postdoctoral Researcher, Chair of Discrete Mathematics, Optimization, and Operations Research

work.name: Mathematics and Computer Science Division, Argonne National Laboratory, Lemont, IL, USA
work.summary: Worked on a globally convergent cutting-plane method for simulation-based optimization with integer constraints
highlights: Derivative-free Optimization, Mixed-Integer Linear Programming, Derivative-free Optimization solvers
work.homepage_description: Research Aide, Mathematics and Computer Science Division

work.name: Mathematics and Computer Science Division, Argonne National Laboratory, Lemont, US
work.summary: Worked on algorithms for Mixed-Integer Derivative-Free Optimization
highlights: Derivative-free Optimization, Mixed-Integer Linear Programming, Optimization solvers

work.name: Tata Steel
work.position: Manager and subsequently, Senior Manager, Process Modelling and Visualization, Technology Group Global Wires and Longs
work.summary: Modelled and provided solutions to optimization problems like 1D cuttingstock problem with multiple stock sizes, job-shop scheduling, vehicle loading (2D) etc. using heuristics and CPLEX solver in long products segment of steel; developed software (using C++, Vb.net, SQL) with embedded optimization modules for end-to-end management of `Cut and Bend' business centres of Tata Steel Ltd. and its partners in Singapore, China, Thailand and India via multiple site visits and customer interactions
highlights: Cutting and Loading, Scheduling, Heuristics, CPLEX

interests.name: Computing
keywords: GPU and Quantum computing in optimization (beginner)

projects.name: Precision Timetabling for Indian Railways (with Centre for Railway Information Systems (CRIS))
projects.summary: Involves timetabling of passenger trains using state-of-art optimization algorithms and computing techniques for Indian railways.

projects.name: Freight Dynamic Pricing for Indian Railways (with Centre for Railway Information Systems (CRIS)) - Co-PI
projects.summary: Involves arriving at dynamic pricing strategies for freight trains for Indian Railways.

projects.name: Theoretical, Computational And Software Advancements In Mixed-Integer Nonlinear Optimization (Industrial Research and Development Unit, IIT Delhi)
projects.summary: Involves advancement of the open-source solver, Minotaur, being jointly developed with a team from IIT Bombay.

projects.name: Development of an Automated Optimal Airline Disruption Management System (with InterGlobe Aviation Ltd (Indigo Airlines))
projects.summary: Involves development of a robust learning and optimization based agent to minimize the cascading losses due to various disruptions.

projects.name: Automatic segmentation and reduction of anomalies in joints for presurgical planning (with Orthopaedic experts team from MAMC)
projects.summary: Involves development of a tool for automatic anomaly detection, segmentation and reduction of joint fracture fragments and tumors for presurgical planning.
